result.rationale: refreshOAuthTokens (new file) returns the raw fetch `response` when sync is enabled — a Response object. The zohocrm CalendarService immediately does `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error`, and zoho-bigin does `tokenInfo.data.error`, which is undefined/TypeError on a Response. Same `.data` access pattern exists in other adapters that expect axios-style responses. When APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, every token refresh takes the broken branch. This is a concrete, diff-verifiable correctness defect.

judged_text: With credential sync enabled, refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response and the code then reads `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error` on an object that has no `.data`. TypeError on every refresh under sync mode, a raw 500 on the booking path instead of a token refresh.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId`, the function performs a `fetch(...)` and returns the raw `Response`. In `packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the caller assigns `const zohoCrmTokenInfo = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and then immediately reads `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error`, which is an Axios response shape. Under sync mode this will be a Fetch `Response` (no `.data`), causing a TypeError and a 500 during token refresh. This mismatch is directly introduced by the diff and is reproducible from the shown code.
